Vera: heads-up bringing up 'helios-hybrid' (mixed-head Gemma variant exported to Llama layout) in int4. Short prompts look fine but after ~90-120 tokens we see abrupt quality collapse and weird phase artifacts. anyone familiar with hetero-head exports?

Hector: what do you mean by mixed-head? different head_dim per head?

Vera: yeah upstream Gemma variant has hetero heads (some heads 64d, some 32d) and the exporter tried to flatten to a uniform head_dim=64 by padding/concatenation. runtime assumed uniform head dims for rotary sin/cos precompute and for kv-cache per-head offsets. snippet from failing run: 
```
[INF] step=115 token=412 logp=-2.6
[INF] step=116 token=189 logp=-12.9
[ERR] rotary idx out-of-range for head 3 (expected size 64 but got 32)
```

Maya: ah. exporter padding can hide the layout but rotary math uses head-specific dims. If exporter didn't emit a head_map or runtime didn't apply per-head scaling, phase will be computed wrong for padded heads. That can look like sudden collapse when the first token needing that head appears.

Hector: also check kv-cache offsets: some fast paths compute a per-head stride assuming uniform head_size, so the packed k/v offsets will be wrong if heads are hetero -> cache reads return garbage and attention collapses mid-sequence.

Vera: confirmed: exporter produced no head_map and loader ignored padded_heads flag. quick local test: when I force runtime to use per-head sin/cos (computed from actual head sizes from model.meta) the issue disappears. ppl: baseline 13.0 -> bad-export 27.8 -> with-headmap 13.2.

Maya: excellent. action items: 1) exporter must emit head_map + head_sizes in meta; 2) runtime should refuse to load if head_sizes inconsistent and no head_map provided (or provide a compatibility shim with clear warnings); 3) rotary precompute must support per-head sin/cos and avoid token-id based memoization; 4) add a unit test that simulates mixed-heads and asserts no logp jump in 3 seeds.

ci-bot: build 4042 queued for exporters on branch onboard/helios-headmap :gear:

Vera: i'll open PR with exporter change + loader assert + test + a short doc entry in onboarding/head_layouts.md describing the caveat and a repro script: 
```
python -m tests.repro_hetero --model helios_conv --prompt tests/long_hard.txt --max-tokens 200
```

Hector: also add runtime verification for kv-cache stride calculation and a fallback to slower per-head offsets when hetero detected. Canary it on dedicated us-west-2.

ops-bot: scheduled canary run (24h) on dedicated-us-west-2, job id j-8811

Maya: nice triage. Also note in docs: padding heads to match a larger dim can mask some tests but rotaries and cache layouts will still break unless head_map is explicit. don't let exporters silently pad without metadata.

Vera: will include, tagging Hector/Maya for review. thanks :thumbsup:
summary: Heterogeneous-head model exported without head_map caused rotary precompute and kv-cache stride mismatches leading to mid-sequence collapse; fixed by emitting head_map, runtime checks, per-head sin/cos, and tests
